                 [a (point line lo)] [b (point line hi)]
                 [cells (for/list ([p (in-range (+ lo 1) hi)]) (point line p))])
            (if (and #t #t #t)
                cells '()))))])
    (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c)
      (if (member (list r c) bridges) 8 (cell-at capped r c)))))))
